text: Metal climbs the same way. The Yan, the Mazask, the Tanka.

Job two. The fortress is standing on three crystals. Its Mining is five.
This is the Yan. Hits for one. Shield of three. Collects up to three crystals a turn. Cannot walk. That is the Yan.
This is the Mazask. Hits for one. Shield of four. Collects up to four crystals a turn. Walks one. That is the Mazask.
This is the Tanka. Hits for two. Shield of five. Collects up to five crystals a turn. Walks two. That is the Tanka.
